data.one_liner: Flutter widget for animated theme switching
data.what_it_does: Provides ThemeProvider, ThemeSwitchingArea, and ThemeSwitcher widgets to animate theme changes. It supports custom clippers and callbacks.
use_when: You need a smooth theme transition in a Flutter app
You want to avoid manual animation code for theme changes
avoid_when: You need persistent theme storage (use shared_preferences separately)
strengths: Easy to integrate with existing MaterialApp
Supports custom animation offsets and callbacks
data.setup_notes: Add dependency and wrap MaterialApp with ThemeProvider
